definitions.explanation: Contributing positively to improvement or development; helpful and productive rather than critical or destructive.

examples.japanese: {建設的|けんせつてき}な{意見|いけん}をお{願|ねが}いします。
もっと{建設的|けんせつてき}な{議論|ぎろん}をしましょう。
examples.english: Let's have a more constructive discussion.

examples.japanese: {建設的|けんせつてき}な{批判|ひはん}は{歓迎|かんげい}します。

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverbial: {建設的|けんせつてき}に (constructively)
・Noun: {建設|けんせつ} (construction) - note: the noun has different meaning

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{建設的|けんせつてき}な{意見|いけん}/{提案|ていあん} (constructive opinion/proposal)
・{建設的|けんせつてき}な{議論|ぎろん}/{対話|たいわ} (constructive discussion/dialogue)
・{建設的|けんせつてき}な{批判|ひはん} (constructive criticism)

Usage note: Often used in business and academic contexts when encouraging productive contributions.
